changelog: Core Principles: added a narrow syntactic safeguard principle that prefers waiting when the preceding span ends in pre-head material and a head noun or essential complement is imminent, without converting common candidates into forbids.

When to Segment: kept permissive surface triggers but added explicit, narrow surface-based conditions that hold candidacy (wait) when pre-head material or a verb-without-object is immediately followed by a likely head/complement within a short token window; exceptions allowed when explicit punctuation separates the parts.

Priority Rules: added calibrated demotion guidance for boundaries that would separate clause-scope modifiers (duration/only/etc.) or split pre-head material from an imminent head, so these cuts are unlikely to survive tight budgets but remain candidates at loose budgets.

Decision Procedure: updated the candidacy pass to include the new syntactic safeguards (hold rules) and instructed the scorer to apply the Priority Rules' demotions; added an operational note to prefer defensible nearby token boundaries when the ideal insertion would force a rewrite of source tokens.
